_source: sequential eval run 6 (docs/evals/2026-08-04-run-6.md), 5/5 cases, 19/19 checks; parallel runs excluded — API contention inflates per-case durations 2-6x (run 3 finding)
_policy: soft ceilings: run-evals.sh prints 'within'/'REGRESSED', never fails the case; update ceilings after each accepted sequential run
_metrics: Three ceilings, because each catches a regression the others miss. max_seconds is wall clock. max_usd is the CLI's own total_cost_usd — the real cost, and the only one that catches a model-mix regression (a sonnet -> opus re-tier keeps token counts flat and triples the bill). max_tokens is attributed.total.tokens — a work-volume proxy that is invariant to pricing, which max_usd is not — so on a max_usd breach, check the rate-table reconciliation in <case>.cost.json before assuming a regression. The one dated price risk is now RETIRED: Sonnet 5's introductory rate expiring 2026-08-31 does not affect these ceilings, because billing was shown to be at list price already (see model-rates.json's _source for the arithmetic). TIE-BREAK (2026-08-06): max_usd is the cost metric of record. When the ceilings disagree, dollars win — token totals are >99% cache reads (they measure conversation shape, not spend) and wall clock measures the experience, not the bill (run 6: security-engineer was 53% of policy's wall clock and a sixth of its bill). Seconds and tokens remain as ceilings because each catches regressions dollars miss; they just do not outvote it. Bimodal exception unchanged: check _bimodal_cases before calling any policy/action number a regression.
_tokens_caveat: Run 6 measured token totals as >99% cache-read tokens in all five cases (e.g. n-plus-one: 3,666,860 cache of 3,669,451 total). Cache reads bill at 0.1x input, so max_tokens tracks context volume x turns far more than it tracks spend. Read it as a work-volume signal and let max_usd speak for cost.
_bimodal_cases: `policy` and `action` each run two ways: the coordinator fast path takes the case (fewer stages, much cheaper) or it delegates. Run 5 delegated `policy` (994s) and fast-pathed `action` (420s); run 6 did the exact opposite (`policy` 381s undelegated, `action` 1217s across 4 agents); a targeted 2026-08-05 run caught `policy` delegating again (1560s, $7.18, 4 agents). The spread on one case is 3.3x in dollars, so BOTH cases' ceilings are seeded to cover the delegating mode — an undelegated run then reads comfortably inside them, and the agent list in <case>.cost.json is what tells you which mode ran. Check that list before treating any REGRESSED reading on these two as a regression.
_opt_in: Three cases are registered but excluded from the default sweep (OPT_IN_CASES in run-evals.sh) because each is expensive and only needs re-measuring when coordinator/team-memory behaviour changes — the coordinator_hash gate below is the trigger that says when. `feature`: the only case guaranteed to delegate, seeded from its first run (2026-08-04): 1456s, $6.55, 11.2M tokens — 5/6 checks; the miss was the stage-budget assertion, later shown in run 7 to be a stale check reading a real pass as a fail (docs/evals/2026-08-06-run-7.md finding 3), so its true score is 6/6. `teach` and `teach-delivery`: run 7's split hypothesis (docs/evals/2026-08-06-run-7-scope.md) — teach/override hold, harvest does not yet (run-7.md finding 2).

n-plus-one.basis: run 6: 302s + headroom. Creeping hard across runs (96 -> 157 -> 178 -> 302) and it breached the previous 250s ceiling — the ceiling is raised to keep carrying information, but the creep itself is run-6 finding 1 and is the thing to explain, not to absorb
n-plus-one.usd_basis: run 6: $1.82 billed + ~30%; no delegation, single opus-5 lane

policy.basis: both modes now measured: 381s undelegated (run 6) and 1560s delegating across 4 agents (2026-08-05). Seeded to cover the delegating mode, so an undelegated run reads far inside it — the agent list in <case>.cost.json, not this ceiling, is what tells you which mode ran
policy.tokens_basis: delegating run: 11,362,290 + ~28%. The undelegated run was 4,371,934
policy.usd_basis: delegating run: $7.18 billed + ~25%. The undelegated run was $2.19 — a 3.3x spread between modes on the same case, which is why the mode matters more than the ceiling

action.basis: run 6: 1217s across 4 agents (qa-engineer, main, tech-lead, backend-developer) + headroom. The previous 600s came from run 5's 420s fast-path run, and its basis note predicted exactly this: 'if the fast path stops taking it, this reads REGRESSED the first time it delegates again — that is the intended signal'. The signal fired as designed; the ceiling now covers the delegating mode
action.tokens_basis: run 6: 9,699,200 across 4 agents + ~30% — the most expensive case in the suite
action.usd_basis: run 6: $5.16 billed + ~30%. 41% of the whole run's $12.50

tests.basis: run 6: 633s, within the existing ceiling — unchanged
tests.tokens_basis: run 6: 3,697,406 + ~30%, of which qa-engineer was 1,978,501 across 39 tool calls

hygiene.basis: run 6: 106s (scrum-master, read-only ledger scan), within the existing ceiling — unchanged
hygiene.tokens_basis: run 6: 579,315 + ~30% — the cheapest case, and the only one on haiku

feature.basis: first run 2026-08-04: 1456s across 4 specialists (database-developer, backend-developer, qa-engineer, tech-lead) + headroom. The most expensive case in the suite, which is why it is opt-in
feature.tokens_basis: first run: 11,189,642 + ~30% — the largest in the suite

teach.usd_basis: run 7: $0.26 billed + ~30% — the cheapest opt-in case, a single-turn artifact write

teach-delivery.basis: run 7 (2026-08-06, docs/evals/2026-08-06-run-7.md): 962s across 4 specialists (main, qa-engineer, database-developer, backend-developer) + ~30%. Run 7's finding 2: this run ended before the coordinator's own delivery-end steps (harvest) fired — a future run that fixes that will very likely run longer, since it adds turns rather than removes them; reseed then rather than pad now for a behaviour that has not been observed yet

coordinator_hash.note: Verified by eval run 7 (2026-08-06, docs/evals/2026-08-06-run-7.md): the feature and teach-delivery cases (both /make-feature-driven) ran billed at exactly this content, recomputed and confirmed equal to the pin before this note was written. The seeding note this replaces is retired.
